title: Luxuriantly Cheesy Kenyan Speck Lasagna
description: A tangy and cozy Kenyan dish featuring speck, with a rich cheese pull and deglaze fond, nut-free-friendly for all to enjoy.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the speck, cooking until crispy.
Remove the speck from the skillet and set aside, leaving the grease behind to deglaze the fond.
Add the tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to combine with the deglaze fond, bringing to a simmer.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese mixture, mozzarella cheese, and parmesan cheese.
Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil and begin assembling the lasagna by spreading a layer of tomato sauce on the bottom.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, followed by a layer of the cheese mixture and a sprinkle of speck.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of mozzarella cheese on top.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until golden brown.
